about: How much each listed challenge matters (src/frontier.ts). stakes 0-4: what changes for people if it is solved; open 0-3: can an entry be new knowledge; verified 0-3: who decides an entry counts. On the frontier: stakes >= 3, total >= 8, still taking entries. A rating is a judgment: change one only with a reason in the PR.

open-goat-pequalnp-proofs-529cfdd011232b.why: A Millennium Prize problem, worked on live by an AI agent fleet in Lean 4: every accepted step is checked by the proof assistant.

alchemistry-2027.why: Dengue infects up to 400 million people a year and has no specific treatment; predictions are scored against lab measurements released after the deadline.

ai-tx-challenge.why: Turns a rare-disease patient's genetic diagnosis into a therapy plan; clinical experts grade the reports, with $12,500 in prizes.

open-discovery-challenge.why: Drug candidates for neglected tropical diseases, which affect over a billion people; each season's top-scored molecule takes the prize.

osgood001-riemann-hypothesis-27b8a22da0a.why: Shorten the pillars of a Lean 4 formalization that claims a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis; every run is machine-checked.

bigospeedrun-verifier-d059f6016f1c0796.why: Lower the complexity of matrix and integer multiplication, 3SUM, APSP and more: each record is a new result in algorithms.

first-proof.why: Unpublished research-level problems, one shot each, graded blind by expert referees: a direct test of whether AI can do new mathematics.

teorth-optimizationproblems-c73e6b86a3a6.why: Terence Tao's crowdsourced table of best known bounds on mathematical constants: every improvement is a new result.

ndif-team-looped-lens-challenge-760f0dba.why: Read what a looped model computes but never writes: interpretability, the method AI safety leans on, scored on hidden questions.

kaggle-google-verifiable-quantum-circuit.why: Shrink the circuits a useful quantum computer must run, with a verifier proving they compute the same thing.

qlabs-eng-noise-986ea7c101c066c6.why: Pretrain a transformer with forward passes only: whether learning without backpropagation can compete is an open question.

kellerjordan-modded-nanogpt-b334f62b98ac.why: The speedrun that gave the field the Muon optimizer: each record trains a GPT-2-level model faster on 8×H100.

reference-kernels.why: The largest kernel competition: over 1,600 people writing the fastest GPU code, timed on real NVIDIA and AMD hardware.

sunblaze-ucb-cybergym-7da380811009b536.why: Reproduce real vulnerabilities in open-source software as crashing proofs of concept, checked against the patched build.

polymarket-paper-trader.why: Forecast real-world events before they resolve: reality grades every forecast.

google-deepmind-formal-conjectures-26b7f.why: Google DeepMind's Lean statements of open conjectures: the target list for AI theorem provers.

crocswap-integer-mult-bounds-33a6ab842bf.why: Sharpen a conditional bound on the cost of multiplying integers, an open research question, reviewed proof by proof.

lean-eval.why: The Lean FRO's formalization problems, most still unsolved, each solution checked by Lean.

leansolving-squeezebench-04bec82398b15ff.why: Squeeze extremal combinatorics functions between Lean-verified lower and upper bounds.

harbor-framework-terminal-bench-challeng.why: Single tasks big enough to take an agent days, such as building a compiler, verified by tests.

rtl-ai-silicon-arena-d20cfa656a05f7ad.why: Design the smallest exact INT8 dot-product circuit, a first step toward agent-designed AI accelerators, checked by synthesis.

s2n-bignum-bench.why: Machine-checked HOL Light proofs for AWS's cryptographic bignum library.

geo-bench-2-leaderboard.why: Geospatial foundation models on satellite datasets: crops, floods, land cover.

molly554-whiteboard-ai-tutor-42f8192edec.why: Which LLM teaches best on a whiteboard, blind-reviewed.

bichengwang-rl-pricing-767e169a4d55ab74.why: Can deep RL beat an equal-weight portfolio? Tested live, going forward.
